'''2011 German National Championship Mario Boley DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mario Boley]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
